ungated_structural_benchmark_runtime.use_rule: Implementation may call the frozen ungated P3 runtime only as the structural comparator defined by P4_response_estimation_v1. P3 official target-ranked result semantics remain forbidden.

response_target_metadata.allowed_now: file existence, exact Git blob hash, and frozen row-count metadata only

qualification_requirements: Exact policy blob and all frozen P4/P3 structural runtime blobs must be verified before qualification.
3D Halton candidate generation must reproduce frozen candidate sanity values and exact 2000-slot null index.
Projected ungated benchmark coordinates must exactly match each P4 candidate sigma/kappa coordinate while removing only the P4 absolute-detection gate.
Canonical null and DCM/zero-gain identities must remain exact.
No response RNG may be introduced.
Equal-colony weighting, primary-only ranking, n-1 secondary scaling, dual 5-of-6 survival math, three-parameter identifiability, and independent final-increment math must be tested on synthetic data.
Qualification must verify the response-target Git blob without parsing target semantics.
Qualification must prove P1/P2/P3 official result semantics and reserved Y-maze data are not loaded.
post_qualification_rule: A successful reference-free estimator qualification may support a later, separate high-resolution authorization record. It does not itself authorize response-target semantic loading or an official scientific search.
